sections.heading: 1. Change the order, go gently
lines: ① Sore arm first into the sleeve.
③ Finger-walk up the wall, 5 times.
④ Move only in a comfortable range.

caption:
Every morning Mr Turtle pulls on his jacket, and every time his second arm reaches back for the sleeve, his shoulder twinges.

That second sleeve asks the shoulder to reach back and rotate a long way, which can be uncomfortable for a sore shoulder. Putting the sore arm in first means less twisting.

Hybi's tip: sore arm in first, 30 seconds of gentle pendulum swings and a few finger-walks up the wall, staying in a comfortable range.

Trouble lifting your arm, pain at night or pain after a fall is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
